adjudication_decisions: Arms are capability-based: full_derived+projection required, negative_control optional; missing optional -> NOT_APPLICABLE (never zero/PARTIAL/PASS); missing required -> UNAVAILABLE; no synthetic nc arm; gold state is oracle not an arm.

Relation evaluation is depth-1 only; targets derived from the FROZEN gold graph, never from observed output; a gold-absent edge is fabricated and fails closed; relation-only stale reference does not count as current.
Audit qa3 supersession requirements use endpoint_policy edge_witness (targets are superseded/stale); impact qi1 depends_on uses all_current_targets_materialized (targets are current).
Forbidden stale-as-current fails ONLY when a listed id is selected as current/pending; absent / stale-relation-endpoint-only / selected-with-stale-status are reported but not failures.

Task-dependence computed over ALL unordered pairs; only intent-level shapes frozen (resume/audit materially_different, audit/impact left_strict_superset, resume/impact materially_different); no exact IDs/counts frozen.
Budget bound to budget-v0.yaml by digest; values unchanged (20000/32); no tuning.

Outcome lattice PASS/FAIL/UNAVAILABLE; PARTIAL not used in eval v1 (legacy report-v1 only); optional diagnostics cannot upgrade a failing required gate; generation success separate from evaluation PASS.
Structural metrics named structural; NOT semantic recall or answerability; no LLM judge.
Migration: eval v0 stays for case-0001; case-0001 bytes unchanged; R3/R3.1 immutable; report.json integration needs a later explicit report-contract revision; o7.b1.report/v1 not redefined.
next: R4B standalone evaluator implementation against synthetic fixtures first; R4C applies it to frozen R3.1 bytes; R4D optional report integration. NOT started.
